title: Postkoloniale stemmen
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Postkoloniale stemmen' examines how the Netherlands’ colonial past in Indonesia continues to resonate in contemporary literature. An international group of literary scholars explores how writers incorporate the Dutch East Indies past into their books, how they relate to their literary predecessors, and what new perspectives they offer on the colonial legacy. They discuss recent work by, among others, Alfred Birney, Marion Bloem, Adriaan van Dis, Anne-Gine Goemans, Dido Michielsen, Gustaaf Peek, Sylvia Pessireron, and Maddy Stolk. In this way, 'Postkoloniale stemmen' offers not only a contemporary literary history of Dutch-Indonesian literature, but also contributes to broader social debates about memory, representation, and the place of postcolonial literature within Dutch culture. The book is intended for anyone interested in the ways in which the colonial past continues to shape the postcolonial present.
